title: Account Executive - Utilities
description:
Role Purpose

LevelTen Energy is on a mission to accelerate the energy transition. We run the world's largest clean energy marketplace, connecting buyers and sellers and enabling them to get deals done faster through market intelligence, software, and transaction tools. Since our founding in 2016, LevelTen's platform has facilitated more than $30billion in clean energy transactions.

Join us on a mission that matters.

LevelTen Energy is looking for a highly motivated, results-driven sales professional to recruit new utilities to subscribe to LevelTen Energy’s complete range of data solutions. As Account Executive, Utilities, your focus will be growing our book of utility data subscribers, building strong relationships with the origination, resource planning, and corporate strategy professionals who drive utility decision-making, and laying the groundwork for these accounts to grow into LevelTen’s broader transactional marketplace over time. Our sales team combines deep product and industry knowledge with a commitment to understand our clients’ unique challenges and deliver innovative solutions. A LevelTen Account Executive is a brand ambassador, and a crucial part of the growth of the company.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identify and build relationships with key utilities, including investor-owned utilities (IOUs), municipal utilities, and rural electric cooperatives, with a focus on those operating in states with strong RPS requirements and appetite for clean energy.
    • Develop and implement comprehensive account strategies that are aligned with customer goals, working closely with internal teams to ensure successful execution.
  • Lead full sales cycles from prospect to close of platform data subscription sales, with a goal of achieving an annual ARR target within the utility segment, while identifying opportunities to land-and-expand these accounts into LevelTen’s transactional marketplace over time.
  • Cement LevelTen’s market-leading position within the utility community by attending industry events, networking with regulatory affairs, integrated resource planning, and procurement professionals, as well as cultivating long-term partnerships that solidify LevelTen as the preferred source for clean energy market data.
  • Maintain expertise in the evolving regulatory and political landscape driving utility demand for clean energy market data, including RPS requirements and state-level mandates, championing your customers’ needs within the company.
  • Build and maintain a clean and accurate pipeline, including consistent updates and accurate forecasts in the company’s CRM system.
  • Represent utilities’ interests with marketing, product, and executive teams, influencing our go-to-market strategy.
  • Travel up to 30% of the time

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years as a closer in enterprise sales, with a consistent record of quota attainment
  • Experience selling energy-related products, data, or web-based SaaS to utilities, traders and/or other key wholesale power market participants
  • Working fluency in how utilities plan, procure, and transact for power; enough to hold a credible conversation with a resource planner or an originator
  • Discipline in CRM use, pipeline hygiene, and accurate forecasting
  • Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal skills, both in-person and virtually
  • Ability to thrive in a constantly changing and evolving work environment

Strongly Preferred:

  • Direct experience in origination, IRP and resource planning, corporate energy procurement, and/or power trading
  • Experience selling analytics or market data subscriptions, as opposed to transactional or project-based products
  • Familiarity with an established sales methodology such as MEDDPICC or Challenger

Additional Details

This full-time position is based in LevelTen Energy’s Seattle office or remote. Salary and incentives commensurate with experience.

  • This position is preferably based in the Seattle area (3 days per week in office/hybrid)
    Remote candidates with the right experience are also welcome.
  • The estimated base salary for this position is $110,000 - $130,000, depending on location and experience. This role is designed for high-impact sellers and features a substantial commission structure with significant upside, alongside an equity grant. This combination ensures a highly competitive total compensation package that rewards over-performance.

Benefits / Perks

  • Full Medical, Vision and Dental coverage
  • Wellness Credit
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • 401k plan

About LevelTen Energy

LevelTen Energy is the leading provider of transaction infrastructure for the renewable energy economy. Our platform delivers buyers, sellers, advisors, and financiers the automation software, data management, and standardized contracts needed to facilitate faster, safer renewable energy transactions. LevelTen’s marketplace of renewable energy power purchase agreements is the world’s largest, enabling over 20 GW of transactions, and spanning 29 countries in North America and Europe. LevelTen’s CFO-Ready Analytics automatically calculate more than a billion data points every day, providing our partners with leading-edge, real-time risk and value insights at modern market scale. Together, LevelTen and our partners share #OneGoal to accelerate the clean energy transition. Visit us at LevelTenEnergy.com to learn more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

LevelTen Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior AI Enablement Specialist
description:
Role Purpose

LevelTen Energy’s mission is to accelerate the energy transition by facilitating frictionless transactions. As the leading provider of renewable transaction infrastructure, we deliver the cloud-based software, centralized supply, automated analytics, and transaction expertise required to power the renewable energy economy. The LevelTen Platform is the world’s largest online hub for renewable energy buyers, sellers, advisors, asset owners and financiers, and delivers the online tools and expertise they need to buy, sell and finance assets quickly.

Join us on a mission that matters.

LevelTen Energy is looking for a hands on Senior AI Enablement Specialist to serve as our internal AI expert and the driving force behind how we build, secure, and scale AI across the organization. This is a technical individual contributor role — you will roll up your sleeves to build agentic workflows, implement AI governance and security best practices, train our teams on the Claude ecosystem, and identify high-impact use cases across all departments. You'll sit within IT but operate largely independently, serving as the person employees, department heads, and the IT team itself turn to for AI guidance, troubleshooting, and capability building. If you can talk about AI but can't build with it, this role isn't the right fit.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • AI Building & Automation: Build, deploy, and maintain agentic workflows, AI automations, and lightweight integrations across the Claude ecosystem. Prototype solutions for teams, troubleshoot when things break, and serve as the go-to resource when employees hit a wall with AI tooling. Work with APIs, MCP servers, prompt engineering, and connected platforms — and know when something needs IT or Infrastructure involvement and how to hand it off cleanly.

  • AI Security & Governance: Serve as the AI security resource within IT — advising on best practices, implementing governance frameworks, and ensuring AI adoption at LevelTen stays secure and compliant. This includes data classification guidance, access controls, audit logging for AI usage, shadow IT risk mitigation, and vendor security reviews for new AI tools. You'll be the person IT and Security lean on when AI-specific security questions arise, operating within our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 environment.

  • Enablement & Uplift: Work directly with employees and teams through one-on-ones, small group workshops, and hands-on build sessions to help non-technical staff get more out of Claude. The goal isn't awareness — it's capability. You're helping people build automations, use advanced features, and work more effectively with AI in their specific role.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with department heads to identify workflows where AI can drive efficiency, reduce manual work, or unlock new capabilities. Translate what you learn into solutions you can actually build and deploy alongside the team.

  • Process Building & Metrics: Build the intake process, adoption metrics, and feedback loops that don't exist yet. Design these from scratch with the freedom to make them work for LevelTen's culture and scale. Track what's working, surface what isn't, and use that data to continuously improve how the company uses AI.

  • Market Research: Stay current on the AI landscape — not just the hype, but what's actually relevant to LevelTen. Evaluate new tools against our security and compliance standards before they reach employees, and bring back practical recommendations.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of technical experience in a hands-on role — AI development, technical product management, systems engineering, or similar — with at least 2 years of direct AI building experience as an individual contributor. You've owned and built things yourself, not managed a team to do it for you.

  • Deep Claude Ecosystem Fluency: You know what Skills, Artifacts, Projects, Cowork, and MCP are and have used them in practice. You've built agents and workflows in Claude, not just prompted it. If we ask you to demo something in the interview, you can pull it up.

  • Proven AI Builder: You have something to show for it — a workflow, an agent, an integration, a tool. You're comfortable working with APIs, prompt engineering, and lightweight integrations without needing engineering support for every step.

  • AI Security Awareness: You understand the security implications of AI adoption — data flows, prompt injection risks, model data retention policies, shadow IT — and you're comfortable serving as the AI security resource alongside an IT and InfoSec team. Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, or NIST frameworks is a plus.

  • Self-Directed: You don't need to be told what to build or how to prioritize. You identify the gaps, design the solution, and execute — escalating cleanly when something requires access or infrastructure outside your scope.

  • Strong Communicator: You can explain a multi-agent architecture to an engineer and explain why AI matters to someone in HR — and you know those are two completely different conversations. One-on-ones, small group sessions, and hands-on build workshops are all in your comfort zone.

  • Collaborative and Empathetic: You meet people where they are. Helping a non-technical employee build their first automation requires as much patience and communication skill as building the underlying infrastructure — and you bring both.

  • IC-Oriented: You're energized by building and enabling, not managing people. You measure success by what gets built, what gets adopted, and how much AI capability you've added to the organization.

  • Self-Driven Practitioner: You experiment with AI on your own time because you're genuinely curious, not because it's on your performance review. You stay current and bring what you learn back to the team in practical, applicable ways.

Benefits / Perks

  • Full Medical, Vision and Dental coverage
  • Wellness Credit
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • 401k

In the Seattle office:

  • Casual dress code
  • Commuter benefits
  • Standing desk options
  • Regular company-sponsored happy hours
  • Hybrid in-office/work from home schedule

Additional Information

  • This position is based out of our office in the Belltown neighborhood of Seattle, WA (hybrid work schedule).
  • The estimated compensation for this position is $140,000-180,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications. In addition, this position is eligible for an annual bonus and an equity grant.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without a current or future need for visa sponsorship.

About LevelTen Energy

LevelTen Energy is the leading provider of transaction infrastructure for the clean energy transition, connecting buyers, sellers, and financiers through dynamic marketplaces, data-driven insights, and automated analytics. The LevelTen Platform supports power purchase agreements, clean energy asset M&A transactions, and tax credit transfers—soon expanding to granular certificate trading—enabling organizations to execute and manage transactions with confidence. With a network of over 1,000 project developers in 35 countries, LevelTen is advancing carbon-free energy markets by increasing transparency, liquidity, and accessibility. Learn more at LevelTenEnergy.com.

title: Vice President of Marketing
description:
Role Purpose

LevelTen Energy is on a mission to accelerate the energy transition. We run the world’s largest clean energy marketplace, connecting buyers and sellers, and enabling them to get deals done faster with cutting-edge market intelligence reports and software, and transaction tools. Since being founded in 2016, LevelTen’s platform has facilitated over $14.8 billion in clean energy transactions.

Join us on a mission that matters.

LevelTen Energy is hiring a Vice President of Marketing to lead the company through its next phase of growth. This is a role for a versatile leader with significant global leadership experience — someone who spans brand, product marketing, demand generation and communications, who has built and motivated high-performing distributed teams, and who is as comfortable setting strategy as executing it. You'll join a smart, global team working on meaningful solutions to the climate crisis, and we have a good time doing it.

Key Responsibilities

As Vice President of Marketing, you'll lead a global team through LevelTen's most ambitious phase yet: doubling revenue year over year while reinforcing the company’s position as the definitive voice in clean energy procurement. You'll own the full marketing and communications function — brand, demand generation, product marketing, PR and executive communications — and you'll build the team, systems and market narrative to support that growth. Key responsibilities include:

  • Brand Strategy: You'll build an updated narrative about our market position — who we serve, the problems we solve, how we do it, and why it matters — and then translate it into messaging, visual identity and standards the whole company can use. You'll work directly with the executive team to shape this story and bring it to market across owned, earned and paid channels.
  • Team Leadership: Lead and grow a global marketing team distributed across North America and Europe, along with a six-figure budget and the agency and consultant relationships behind it. You'll coach and develop the people on this team, shape how the function is organized as we scale, and build the kind of morale that holds up under rapid growth. You'll keep the team oriented toward commercial outcomes — every program tied to pipeline, revenue or market position — and you'll set the tone for how we work: self-belief, professionalism, a bias for action, and a practice of instigating progress rather than waiting for it.
  • Product Marketing: You'll oversee the launch and scale of new products, establish account-based marketing programs, and sharpen segmentation and positioning across a technical buyer base. Existing knowledge of clean energy markets in North America and Europe is required, with a working knowledge of power purchase agreements, RECs/GOs and similar energy products a strong plus.
  • Demand Generation, Marketing Operations and Analytics: Support ongoing demand generation in close partnership with the VP of Sales, and expand the measurement infrastructure behind LevelTen's growth. Working with external consultants, you'll lead your team to establish attribution, reporting and marketing ROI analysis, along with the systems that turn funnel data into actionable insight about our customers.
  • Executive Communications: Establish and own the executive communications program for both external and internal audiences. You'll develop LevelTen's corporate positions on emerging and sensitive industry issues, lead the narrative behind white papers and investor communications, and prepare our executives to deliver it — in the boardroom, on stage and in the press.
  • Public Relations: Lead LevelTen's media relations program across North America and Europe. Internal and external teams support execution, but you'll stay hands-on — sometimes working directly with reporters on brand, customer and product storytelling, managing proactive and reactive news cycles, and occasionally serving as a public face of the company. You'll also prepare and brief our spokespeople for high-tier engagements.
  • Events and Social: Shape the future of LevelTen's events program, with an emphasis on securing high-impact speaking opportunities and measuring the ROI of industry conference participation. You'll also ensure we have an organic social media strategy and the policy behind it.
  • Content and Editorial: Provide strategic direction and editorial oversight to our director of content, who owns LevelTen's content program. You'll set the editorial standard, shape the market point of view behind our flagship research, and make sure our content serves both category leadership and pipeline. Final editorial judgment on our most visible work rests with you.
  • Website: Own the website. A phased refresh is already underway, and you'll drive it across the finish line — then keep going, aligning the site with our evolving brand narrative, refreshing visuals, and optimizing for how buyers search today, including AI-driven and generative search. You'll own conversion performance, information architecture, and the launch cycle that keeps the site current as new products ship.

Qualifications

  • At least 15 years in marketing and communications.
  • 5 years of experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing marketing teams in a global environment.
  • Business acumen that connects marketing decisions to pipeline, pricing and growth targets.
  • Impeccable writing skills, with the ability to calibrate content depth, voice, and tone across diverse platforms, ensuring every message resonates with its intended audience.
  • Strong verbal communication skills that allow you to deliver clear and compelling information to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Adeptness at building relationships, forging consensus across opposing viewpoints, and navigating executive-level engagement.
  • Excellent project management capabilities and a keen sense of judgment on how to balance competing priorities.
  • Systems thinking that drives you to design processes that streamline workflows and achieve long-term efficiency.
  • Experience managing budgets, vendors, and reporting on ROI/KPIs.
  • Experience working successfully with international teams and navigating cultural differences.
  • Strongly desired:
    • Experience with and/or strong understanding of clean energy, renewables and/or the energy transition; and
    • Experience working successfully with international teams and navigating cultural differences.

Additional details

  • This position is based out of our office in the Belltown neighborhood of Seattle, WA (hybrid work schedule).
  • The estimated compensation for this position is $180,000-200,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications. In addition, this position is eligible for an annual bonus and an equity grant.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without a current or future need for visa sponsorship. LevelTen Energy does not offer visa assistance or sponsorship of any kind.

Benefits / Perks

  • Full Medical, Vision and Dental coverage
  • Wellness Credit
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • 401k plan

In the Seattle office:

  • Casual dress code
  • Commuter benefits
  • Standing desk options
  • Regular company-sponsored happy hours
  • Hybrid in-office/work from home schedule
  • Monthly catered lunch

LevelTen Energy is the leading provider of transaction infrastructure for the renewable energy economy.
